pages.text: After 60 more seconds of wear at sweat level 3 (configurable), you catch $(bold)foot fungus$() — it has $(bold)infinite duration$(): taking boots off or pouring sweat does NOT cure it.$(br2)$(bold)The only cure$(): pour a bottle of $(bold)floral water$() into a water basin to turn it medicinal, then sit on a stool, take off your boots and soak until done (see "Washing & Curing").

$(bold)Spread$(): standing near an infected player can infect you, and the newly infected can spread it further.$(br2)After curing it, wearing boots again requires $(bold)reaching level 3 plus another 60 s of wear$() before it can infect you again — no instant relapse.$(br2)For the exact symptoms (slowdown, sneezing, smell) and config values, see "Mechanics → Fungus Mechanics".
